root_cause.text: The raw_buffer was freed in edt_ft5x06_ts_teardown_debugfs() without holding the device mutex or clearing the pointer, allowing a concurrent debugfs read operation to access freed memory (use-after-free).
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states debugfs files are still accessible after raw_buffer is freed, and the patch adds `guard(mutex)(&tsdata->mutex)` before kfree and sets `tsdata->raw_buffer = NULL`. The debugfs read function already checks raw_buffer under the same mutex, so the locking fix prevents the race.
